summary: This Phase 3 clinical trial is looking at how a type of medicine called a DPP4 inhibitor affects thinking and memory skills in people who have had a stroke and also have type 2 diabetes. The study plans to enroll 312 participants who are between 40 and 75 years old. The status of this trial is Not yet recruiting. The sponsor of this study is Second Affiliated Hospital of Soochow University.

facts.sponsor: Second Affiliated Hospital of Soochow University
